title: German Rheinmetall open-sources its Battlesuite connected weapon system protcol
summary: Rheinmetall, the German defense contractor, has open-sourced documentation for its Battlesuite connected weapon system protocol, publishing an onboard API spec on GitHub. The Hacker News discussion (279 points, 107 comments) debates the implications of publicly releasing military systems' interoperability standards, covering topics like ethical concerns, potential misuse, and the technical design of the protocol.
